verdict.rationale: Restate docs explicitly describe concurrency limits 'per scope' to protect downstream services and control cost (restate-docs-4, restate-docs-11), and Virtual Objects provide natural per-key serialization, but there's no explicit documentation of rate-limiting (as opposed to concurrency capping) or of a per-tenant configuration knob distinct from per-service/per-key scope. Missing for 10: explicit per-tenant rate-limit configuration, request-rate (vs concurrency) limiting mechanisms, and independent/hands-on evidence of fairness under a noisy-tenant scenario.
